operations.description: Search payments by reference, state, 'from' and 'to' date. The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search payments [PATH] payments [PARAMS] brand card cardholder date digits display email first from last name number page reference settled size state to [SCHEMA] card detail details for links navigation payment refund results search settlement state summary

operations.description: Return information about the payment The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] a payment [PATH] payments [PARAMS] id payment [SCHEMA] address card details link links payment refund result settlement state summary

operations.description: Return payment events information about a certain payment The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] events for a payment [PATH] payments events [PARAMS] id payment [SCHEMA] event events for link links payment state

operations.summary: Get all refunds for a payment
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all refunds for a payment [PATH] payments refunds [PARAMS] id payment [SCHEMA] embedded for links refund refunds result search

operations.description: Return payment refund information by Refund ID The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] a payment refund [PATH] payments refunds [PARAMS] id payment refund [SCHEMA] for links refund search settlement summary

operations.description: Search refunds by 'from' and 'to' date. The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search refunds [PATH] refunds [PARAMS] date display from page settled size to [SCHEMA] detail error for links navigation refund results search settlement summary

operations.description: Create a new payment for the account associated to the Authorisation token. The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create a payment [PATH] payments [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] address card cardholder create details link links payment prefilled refund request result settlement state summary

operations.description: Cancel a payment based on the provided payment ID and the Authorisation token. The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'. A payment can only be cancelled if it's in a state that isn't finished.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cancel a payment [PATH] payments cancel [PARAMS] id payment [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Capture a payment based on the provided payment ID and the Authorisation token. The Authorisation token needs to be specified in the 'authorization' header as 'authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'. A payment can only be captured if it's in 'submitted' state
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] capture a payment [PATH] payments capture [PARAMS] id payment [SCHEMA]
